mapper.insert: insert into user_follow (follower_id, followee_id, create_time) values (#{followerId}, #{followeeId}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select u.id as userId, u.name as userName, u.avatar as userAvatar, u.follower_count as followerCount, u.following_count as followingCount, u.liked_count as likedCount, u.post_count as postCount from user_follow uf left join user u on uf.followee_id = u.id where uf.follower_id = #{followerId} order by uf.create_time desc
